svg.title: RS485 wiring: Ubuntu computer, USB adapter and Luckfox Lyra PLC
svg.desc: Connect the adapter USB plug to the computer. Connect adapter GND to PLC pin 6 SGND, A+ to pin 10 TA/A+, and B- to pin 9 TB/B-. Power the PLC separately. The lower diagram is an electrical connection map, not physical terminal order.
svg.text: Ubuntu computer / USB to RS485 adapter / Luckfox Lyra PLC
Electrical connection map. Use the manufacturer pinout for physical terminal positions.
Power the PLC separately (DC 7–24 V). USB powers only the adapter.
Use PLC pins 6, 9 and 10. Leave RS422 RA/RB unconnected. SGND is not PE.
